title: PerezBlanco2026
description: A BIDS-formatted EEG-EMG dataset from 45 healthy adults performing four-direction wrist pointing movements (flexion, extension, radial deviation, ulnar deviation) with a 3-DoF wrist exoskeleton. It contains 8 channels of EEG over sensorimotor areas and 8 channels of EMG, recorded at 512 Hz over multiple runs of cue-based trials with continuous visual feedback. The dataset supports research on motor control, brain-computer interfaces and biomarkers for neurorehabilitation.
methods_description: Recordings used a g.tec g.USBamp amplifier at 512 Hz with 8 EEG channels (10-10 montage, g.GAMMAcap) and 8 EMG channels, referenced to the right ear with AFz as ground. Online filtering was a 0.1-200 Hz bandpass and a 60 Hz notch. Participants performed 8 or more runs of 40 trials each (10 per movement direction) with a wrist exoskeleton, where flexion-extension controlled horizontal cursor motion and radial-ulnar deviation controlled vertical cursor motion. Data were converted from BCI2000 .dat files to EDF in BIDS.
